raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "plant"
  role subject "Ghiță"
  role object "lavender"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "cook at"
  role subject "Chen"
  role object "the Old Mill Hall"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "cook at"
  role subject "Javier"
  role object "the Community Centre on Elm Street"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "rent"
  role subject "Aiko"
  role object "the vineyard near Sibiu"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "be a member of"
  role subject "Lukas"
  role object "the Madrigal choir"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "be repaired by"
  role subject "the yellow taxi"
  role object "Petru"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "be repaired by"
  role subject "the hospital ambulance"
  role object "Corina"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "lease"
  role subject "Élodie"
  role object "the recording studio"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "grow"
    role subject ?x
    role object "pumpkins"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be repaired by"
    role subject "the fire engine"
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Florică"

@q3 query
  select ?t
  measure start
  where match
    relation "be repaired by"
    role subject "the school bus"
    role object "Luminița"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "plant"
    role subject "Joaquín López"
    role object "peppers"
    polarity affirmed
  end
